memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks 2 km daily, tailors clothes without difficulty.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5, no impairment detected.
falls: 0 falls in past 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular (clobetasol 0.05% cream BD, calcipotriol ointment OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg OD, silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Reports good spirits, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Son, Arjun Kumar.
goals: "I want to stay active and keep tailoring."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
clobetasol 0.05% cream apply BD to affected areas
calcipotriol ointment apply OD to plaques
methotrexate 7.5 mg take orally once weekly on same day
folic acid 5 mg take OD
silymarin 140 mg take TDS with meals
rosuvastatin 5 mg take OD at night

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Mild joint stiffness in mornings, still manages tailoring with occasional breaks.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (annual screen due), no change.
falls: 0 falls last 12 months, gait slightly cautious, timed up-and-go 10 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (add hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, increase methotrexate to 10 mg weekly). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Reports occasional frustration with joint pain, denies depression.
carers: Son, Arjun Kumar.
goals: "I want to keep working without pain slowing me down."

memories.text:
function: Mild fatigue noted, still able to work 5-6 hours daily with rests.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (annual screen), score ≤2 triggers further assessment; plan for MoCA.
falls: 1 fall in past 12 months (tripped over rug, no injury), gait slightly unsteady, timed up-and-go 13 seconds (raised fall risk).
medicines: 8 regular (reduce prednisolone to 2.5 mg OD). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Reports occasional low mood, denies hopelessness.
carers: Son, Arjun Kumar.
goals: "I want to stay steady on my feet and keep stitching."

memories.text:
function: Reports increased hand swelling and stiffness, tailoring slower but still manages.
cognition: MoCA score 26/30, normal.
falls: 0 falls last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 8 regular (continue current doses). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Frustrated with limitation, denies depression.
carers: Son, Arjun Kumar.
goals: "I want to keep my hands working as long as possible."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Message via clinic app: "Doctor, my finger joints feel sore and swollen especially in the mornings. It’s hard to grip the needle. Can we check my hands?"

memories.author: D06
memories.text: X-ray of both hands: periarticular osteopenia, mild joint space narrowing at MCP and PIP joints, no erosions. Consistent with early rheumatoid arthritis changes.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Rheumatology, Bangalore General Hospital for assessment of progressive hand synovitis and consideration of disease-modifying therapy adjustment.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Rheumatology review: Confirmed active RA, DAS28 4.2. Recommended add leflunomide 20 mg OD and continue methotrexate, hydroxychloroquine, low-dose prednisolone. Return to primary care for monitoring.
